stages.name: Image vulnerability scan
stages.failureReason: Trivy found CVE-2025-21614 (critical, CVSS 9.8) in base image layer 'node:20.11-alpine'. Gate policy blocks deployment on critical CVEs with a known exploit path.
stages.remediation: Rebuild on node:20.19-alpine3.21 which carries the patched libcrypto3 3.3.2-r4, then re-run the image scan stage.

stages.name: Unit testing
stages.failureReason: Unit test suite failed: 3 assertions in session-store.test.ts — token rotation returns stale refresh token when clock skew exceeds 30s.
stages.remediation: Fix the rotation guard in src/auth/session-store.ts:141 to compare against server-issued iat rather than local clock.

pullRequest.title: Key vault firewall exception for build agents

stages.name: Checkov Terraform scan
stages.failureReason: Checkov CKV_AZURE_109: Key Vault network ACL default action is 'Allow' in module.identity_kv — public network access would be enabled.
stages.remediation: Set network_acls.default_action = "Deny" and add the AKS subnet to allowed virtual_network_subnet_ids in infrastructure/modules/key-vault.

findings.title: Key Vault public network access enabled
